1: The last sentence draws the conclusion: adopting a pet can be considered a valid medical support for anxiety — C. The survey, doctors' recommendations and therapeutic claims are the support.
2: The results come from a survey on the university's own site that students chose to answer, so the respondents may not be typical (self-selection), and there's no comparison with other universities — D.
4: Banning phones improves results only if fewer distractions really lead to better focus and results — D.
5: 20 pages in 8 minutes is 2.5 pages a minute; 30 × 2.5 = 75 pages.

9: The director 'believes that entrance fees are the main obstacle to public engagement with culture' — so removing them is the best way to boost interest (D). The 40% rise is the evidence.
10: Structure: he can't manage A; B is even more so; so he can't manage B. C matches: tea keeps him awake; coffee has even more caffeine; so he won't drink it either.
11: Vertical farms produce a lot with little space and water, and cities are growing. So urban farming may help meet food needs in growing cities — C. The others go too far.
12: Public funding is justified by social benefits rather than private ones. That assumes the social benefits outweigh the individual gains — C.

15: Proponents say well-being means fewer sick days. B confirms it: absenteeism has dropped.
17: Club members get better grades, so the school says clubs cause better grades. Correlation doesn't prove causation — C.
18: Everyone has equal access, so everyone pays the same: equal opportunity justifies equal cost — C.

21: Work out all 12 ratios front ÷ rear. Only one pair repeats: 40/20 = 48/24 = 2. So there are 11 different ratios.
